highlights: Catered BBQ published at £32.95pp, for at least 40 guests
Prepped DIY BBQ kit from £22.95pp, minimum of 10
Signature burgers, fries and halloumi fries from £12.00pp
Essex-farmed dry-aged beef, ground fresh daily
Made-from-scratch spiced bean patty on its restaurant menu

howItWorks.title: Send an enquiry
howItWorks.text: Fill in the enquiry form on the catering page, choosing from in-home, event, corporate, BBQ kit or other services, and add a message about the event.

howItWorks.title: Get an accurate quote
howItWorks.text: Meat Stop says it will be in touch shortly after an enquiry with an accurate quote for the event.

goodToKnow.text: Published minimum numbers apply: at least 40 guests for the catered BBQ and at least 10 for the prepped DIY kit. No minimum is stated for the Signature Collection.
Catering prices are published per head, and the business asks hosts to get in touch for an accurate quote for their event. The enquiry form also asks about budget.

The restaurant menu includes a made-from-scratch spiced bean patty, and any burger can be swapped to a fermented vegetable patty from Symplicity for +1. The catering menus do not say whether these are offered at events, so it is worth asking when enquiring.
For festivals, food markets and pop-ups, Meat Stop describes its set-up as compact and high-output, built to serve consistently in the busiest environments.
For corporate catering, such as lunches, client events and team celebrations, the business says it provides a professional set-up and swift, seamless service.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum number of guests?
faqs.a: For the catered 3 Meats & 3 Salads BBQ, the published minimum is 40 guests; the prepped DIY kit starts at 10. The Signature Collection lists a per-head price without a stated minimum.

faqs.q: Where does the beef come from?
faqs.a: Meat Stop says its beef is dry-aged, farmed locally in Essex and ground fresh daily.

The restaurant menu offers a spiced bean patty made from scratch, which the business says is 'not a token veggie option', and a fermented vegetable patty swap for any burger. The catering page does not say whether these are available for events.

Meat Stop says it is active across Essex, including Colchester, Chelmsford, Southend, Braintree, Clacton, Harlow, Leigh-on-Sea, Thurrock, Basildon, Billericay, Epping and Maldon, and many surrounding areas.

faqs.q: Can the catering be tailored for a wedding?
faqs.a: On its supplier profile, Meat Stop says it works with couples to customise the experience for wedding receptions.

faqs.q: How do we get a price for our event?
faqs.a: Fill in the enquiry form on the catering page with details of the event, and the business will be in touch with an accurate quote.

serviceDetails.name: Prepped DIY Kit
serviceDetails.more: The catering enquiry form lists 'BBQ Kit' as its own service option, alongside in-home, event and corporate catering.

serviceDetails.name: Burger and BBQ event catering
serviceDetails.more: On its supplier profile, Meat Stop says its event food is built on dry-aged beef, house-made sauces and locally baked brioche buns. It describes a professional set-up for corporate events, works with couples on wedding receptions, and uses a compact, high-output set-up for festivals and pop-ups.

serviceDetails.name: Dry-aged beef burgers in London
serviceDetails.more: The 2026 menu lists triple-cooked 'skins' (crushed baby potatoes) at 4 / 6 plain with Maldon salt, or 5.5 / 8.5 with garlic butter and parmesan or aioli and chimichurri, plus dips at 1.5. Burgers can be customised with an extra patty (+3), bacon (+1.5), cheese (+1) or extra spice (+1), and the 12–3pm lunch deal adds a side of skins for +2.

sources.label: Meat Stop — Add to Event supplier profile (self-description)

notes: Fetched 27 Oct 2026. The official site has only Home, Catering, a 2026 menu PDF and a one-product store page; there is no FAQ, terms, deposit or cancellation policy. Four statements (corporate set-up, wedding customisation, festival/pop-up set-up, and event ingredients) come from the business's own self-written Add to Event supplier profile, not its website, and are attributed to that page. Allergen handling, staffing, cooking equipment, space and power needs, set-up time, food hygiene rating and insurance for event catering are not published. Whether events in London are catered is not stated. The store page sells a 'Deluxe Bacon Cheeseburger' at £12.00 with generic copy; its purpose is unclear, so it was not used. No highlights or details were added for The 3 Meats & 3 Salads Collection or The Signature Collection because nothing beyond the existing profile copy is published about them.
